inputs: hypothetical n/delta/q, no task outcome files read
analysis_plan: final two-sided exact McNemar + Holm for two comparisons at family alpha.05; requiring p<=.025 for each is a conservative sufficient planning event
model_assumptions: independent paired task draws with homogeneous joint probabilities or explicitly declared reference task model; fixed frozen training snapshots
Compatible reference success must lie in [p_loss,1-p_win]; high-q scenarios are not necessarily compatible with an80% baseline
limits: Power is for positive-direction p-value criterion only, not practical-effect/harms/data-integrity/full acceptance gates
Union-bound lower bound uses only two marginal powers; no independence between model comparisons assumed
No q is estimated from old R19, oracle2/36 or target training cases
N values are mathematical scenarios, not certified available identities, approved sample counts or budget
No claim about training-seed variability; exact conditional test is conservative
